name: GUEST IN RESIDENCE
band_note: mean of sweater entry $225 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band (cashmere knit house; proposed Accessible on the $225 crewneck entry)
why: Cashmere sweaters, cardigans, tees, knit pants and accessories for women and men, knits mostly $250–750, sold through its own stores and site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2022 by Gigi Hadid.

quote.q: I love the storytelling of clothes passing through many hands, having previous lives and many still to come.
quote.who: Gigi Hadid, founder and creative director

opview: “I love the storytelling of clothes passing through many hands, having previous lives and many still to come.” — Gigi Hadid, founder and creative director, Discover GIR, guestinresidence.com

facts_read.source: brand site; nordstrom.com; Vinted item and catalogue pages; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Guest In Residence women's knitwear, pants, denim, dresses, jackets; men's, scarves, hats, blankets, socks excluded

doors.note: 4 stores (2 NYC, 2 LA area). Gigi Hadid cashmere brand.

fibre.sample: stratified sample drawn from /products.json (397 products, unisex store; blankets, scarves, hats, socks excluded), proportional by product type; 7 sampled style

craft_evidence.owned: no — 'most of Guest In Residence's products are manufactured in China by Draper HK at its Dongguan Cason Knitted Company Limited factory' (/pages/our-ethics)
craft_evidence.makers: yes — Draper HK, Dongguan Cason Knitted Company Limited factory (Sedex member) (/pages/our-ethics); Re.Verso (Italy) for take-back recycling
craft_evidence.mills: none; cashmere 'sourced from Inner Mongolia', Sustainable Fibre Alliance member
craft_evidence.madein: 39 of 73 sampled descriptions say 'manufactured in China' (100% cashmere pieces); blends and denim state none
craft_evidence.heritage: founded 2022 in New York by Gigi Hadid (/pages/discover-gir)
craft_evidence.process: partial — fibre origin (Inner Mongolia), SFA membership, supplier audits and a take-back to Re.Verso regenerated cashmere; no description of making
craft_evidence.reasoning: Names the factory that makes most of the range (Draper HK's Dongguan Cason Knitted, China) and the fibre origin, and over half of sampled pages say where the piece was made. Third-party making, a four-year-old brand: 3.

notes.tech: Thread proposed 1 (2026-10-14): no named fabric. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
